title: The Schwinger-Dyson equations for random fuzzy geometries coupled to matter
summary: In this work we study the Schwinger-Dyson equations and saddle point equations of matrix integrals that come from type $(0,1)$ random fuzzy geometries coupled to fermions or bosons. Such random fuzzy geometries are bi-tracial Hermitian matrix ensembles with a determinant contribution in the integrand. We derive the Schwinger-Dyson equations using complex analytic techniques from the saddle point equation.
